text:
lia: Heads-up — ran into a rough onboarding run with the python sample app. It fires a prefetch of 4 pages in parallel and we end up with token refresh collisions + sync retries. Result: lots of 429s, duplicated page processing, and the client-side circuit trips.

pranav: Oof. Which python-sdk version and sample config?

lia: python-sdk 0.9.1 (also tried latest main). Config used:
```json
{
  "PREFETCH_PAGES": 4,
  "PAGE_SIZE": 50,
  "MAX_CONCURRENCY": 4,
  "TOKEN_REFRESH_BEFORE_S": 12
}
```
Logs (slice):
```
2026-03-20T08:20:01Z INFO prefill:start pages=4
2026-03-20T08:20:02Z WARN request 429 route=/chat.generate
2026-03-20T08:20:02Z INFO refresh:started
2026-03-20T08:20:03Z ERROR refresh:error 502
2026-03-20T08:20:04Z WARN request retrying route=/chat.generate attempt=1
2026-03-20T08:20:04Z ERROR duplicate page processed id=page-3
2026-03-20T08:20:05Z ERROR client circuit open: too many failures
```
This happens right on first-run in CI when we exercise onboarding. New users hit it and think service is flaky.

carla: Thanks for the repro. I think this is a parity + default config issue. Python's retry strategy uses deterministic exponential backoff without jitter (base=300ms, factor=2). go and node have randomized jitter. When prefill fires N requests they align.

dave: Two quick fixes: 1) change sample defaults to PREFETCH_PAGES=2 and MAX_CONCURRENCY=2, 2) add full jitter to python retry loop. Longer-term: make prefill sequential by default in onboarding flow, or add adaptive gating (stop prefill if token provider error seen).

lia: I validated locally that PREFETCH_PAGES=2 avoids the circuit trip. Adding jitter in the client also helped but we still saw duplicated page items because the paginator doesn't dedupe in retries.

pranav: Can we add idempotency keys on page fetches? Paginator should ignore an already-processed page id. Also add a small per-page random delay when prefetching to spread load.

carla: I'll open a small PR to: add jitter to python retry, add idempotency check in paginator, and change sample defaults. We'll keep prefill enabled but less aggressive.

lia: Please also add a quick warning in the README and a sample ENV var hint: "If you see 429s on first-run set PREFETCH_PAGES=2". New users need an obvious mitigation.

pranav: Also creating telemetry task: emit 'onboard.prefill.failure' with tags (sdk=python, prefetch=4) so we can alert when this regresses.

ci-bot: Canary deploy of sample-python v0.4.2 scheduled for 2026-03-20T12:00:00Z.

carla: Thanks — I'll post links to the PR and issue here once created.

lia: Cheers, attaching a tiny repro repo after lunch for those who want to run it locally.
